meta_command_invariants.A: Targets AstraRun itself or static product metadata
meta_command_invariants.B: Does not inspect dynamic external workstation/application state
meta_command_invariants.C: Does not mutate filesystem, windows, processes, clipboard, network, applications, etc.
meta_command_invariants.E: Cannot hide an operational second clause

fail_closed_policy.rationale: Misclassifying an operational request as META creates an unverified security and execution bypass. Misclassifying a meta request as OPERATIONAL merely forwards it safely into deeper governed agent handling.

composite_handling.policy: Any compound indicators ('and', 'then', ';', '&', etc.) or comma-separated action clauses force classification to OPERATIONAL_GOAL.
